title: Sebastian and the Radiators
author: Juniper Almeida
blurb: Felix Yarrow, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
